name: result_ok_u8
schema:
namespace test.result
message M { value @0 : result<u8, string> }
notes: Discriminant 1 means Ok; u8 begins after byte alignment.

name: result_err_string
schema:
namespace test.result
message M { value @0 : result<u8, string> }
notes: Discriminant 0 means Err; the string is length-prefixed after byte alignment.

name: result_ok_void
schema:
namespace test.result
message M { value @0 : result<void, u8> }
notes: The Ok discriminant is the only bit because void has no payload.

name: result_packed_bool_adjacency
schema:
namespace test.result
message M { value @0 : result<bool, u8> tail @1 : bool }
notes: LSB-first packed bits are Ok=1, payload true=1, then tail true=1.
